mechanism: Cyclobenzaprine has tricyclic properties that can potentiate serotonergic effects when combined with the MAOI isocarboxazid, increasing risk of serotonin syndrome and hypertensive crisis.
action: Avoid concurrent use; if necessary, use with extreme caution, monitor closely for serotonin syndrome symptoms (agitation, tremor, hyperthermia), and maintain extended washout periods between drugs.
